description: SRUP - Carta de Perigosidade de Incêndio Rural is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Service and Public Utility Restriction (SRUP) - Rural Fire Hazard Letter, in force in mainland Portugal. Rural fire hazard mapping is one of the components of rural fire hazard mapping in accordance with Article 41.º(1) of Decree-Law No 82/2021 of 13 October 2021. Coverage: Direção-Geral do Território. The portal shows the English title as "SRUP - Rural Fire Hazard Letter" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral do Território. Its keywords include srup, cartografia-oficial, snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt, icnf, infomapaccessservice, dgt. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP, WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2023-06-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
